title: TavernFinder
description: Find tabletop events, venues, and games. RSVP, register, create events via personal token.
summary: Find tabletop events, venues, and games. RSVP, register, create events via personal token.
offersHint: Find tabletop events, venues, and games. RSVP, register, create events via personal token. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.tavernfinder.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_events
toolsPreview.description: Search for upcoming tabletop gaming events (tournaments, leagues, casual play) near a location.

toolsPreview.name: search_venues
toolsPreview.description: Search for local game stores, hobby centers, and community spaces.

toolsPreview.name: search_games
toolsPreview.description: Search for board games in our catalog to find their BoardGameGeek IDs (required for filtering events by game).

toolsPreview.name: rsvp_event
toolsPreview.description: RSVP / join a TavernFinder event on behalf of the authenticated user. Requires a personal access token with the `write:rsvp` scope. Use search_events first to find the venueId + eventId pair.

toolsPreview.name: register_user
toolsPreview.description: Create a new TavernFinder account. Returns access + refresh tokens that the agent can use immediately. The new user is unverified until they click the email verification link, but most read paths still work.

toolsPreview.name: create_event
toolsPreview.description: Create a new event (open event or private table) at a venue on behalf of the user. Requires a personal access token with the `write:create_event` scope. The user must be a member of the venue (player role at minimum); only staff/CL can create open events.
